entries.hobb: Small humanoid with endless stomachs. It has 3 stomachs, each able to turn anything into nutrients, and stands 48 cm tall. If starved for over an hour it eats anything around it, and its teeth get strong enough to bite through metal. The first anomaly ever captured.
entries.editor: A quiet presence that edits geography while unobserved: a door moves a metre, a stair gains a step. It cannot change anything under direct observation. Countered by Constant Watch.
entries.john_arms: Once human, now arms for every body part: eyes held by hands, a tongue that is an arm, fingers for teeth. Completely harmless unless attacked first. Flurry: it spins at up to 80 km/h and smashes anything it hits into the wall behind it, but tires out quickly. Treat it with respect and it respects you back.
entries.kardemosh: An autonomous mechanical humanoid that became self-aware and craves to be human. It rips the skin off humans and stitches it onto its own body, a patchwork of many people. The skin decays, forcing it to hunt again. Calm while wearing enough skin. Saying "Halt!" stops it dead and it takes about a minute to reset, but overusing the exploit lets it adapt. Prefers the name Kardemosh, "God of Flesh".
entries.gasket: An inescapable coffin. It never attacks, but whoever lies down in it feels comfort so deep they never want to leave. Works on only one person at a time. Hard counter: leave it be. Notes: Do. Not. Enter. The. Gasket.
entries.creeler: A tall, spindly thing that hangs from ceilings. Its ribcage opens like a creel, a fisherman's basket trap. It lowers itself silently, closes around a person and lifts them away. No one taken has been found.
entries.spiker: A seed-like anomaly. Wherever it lands, black spikes erupt from the ground within seconds and keep growing as long as something living stands nearby.
entries.dargalean: A small, gentle creature with big eyes. Everyone who sees it feels an urge to go pet it. Harmless, but staff keep "losing" hours in its room.
entries.spacefarer: A humanoid alien who claims to be a human from the future. Intersex, like everyone of their species. Barely needs food or water and only 3 hours of sleep. Safe if kept fed and talked to.
entries.individuals: Top halves of human heads sticking out of the ground, sliding around like slugs and staring. Their gaze fills you with dread until they blink. Through a screen they look 2D. Throw something behind them and they all turn. Harmless, just creepy.
entries.chain: An ordinary-looking steel chain. Anything it touches becomes linked: what happens to one happens to the other.
